name: busybar
description: Draw, show pictures and play sounds on your BUSY Bar, and see a summary of every answer on it when Claude finishes.

BUSY_ADDR.title: BUSY Bar address
BUSY_ADDR.description: IP on your Wi-Fi, 10.0.4.20 over USB, or https://api.busy.app with a cloud token. Empty: USB.

BUSY_HTTP_PASSWORD.title: HTTP access password
BUSY_HTTP_PASSWORD.description: Only if the Bar has HTTP access locked.

BUSY_TOKEN.title: BUSY cloud token
BUSY_TOKEN.description: From cloud.busy.app/api-tokens, to reach the Bar from anywhere.

GITHUB_TOKEN.title: GitHub token
GITHUB_TOKEN.description: For the GitHub tools. Empty: uses `gh auth token` if the GitHub CLI is logged in.

NOTIFY.title: Answer-ready notifications
NOTIFY.description: Show a short summary on the Bar when Claude finishes an answer or waits for you.

NOTIFY_SOUND.title: Notification chime
NOTIFY_SOUND.description: Play a short chime with each notification.
